profile.headline: SWE Intern @ Southwest Airlines
profile.summary: Computer Science student excelling at rapidly integrating into new projects and contributing to ongoing efforts. Quickly adapts to novel skills, production realities, and techniques. Passionate about expanding aptitudes to help employers diversify available skills and drive new customer growth.

positions.title: Technology Support Representative
positions.description:
Deliver Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for hardware, software, and network systems, resolving technical issues across departments and ensuring minimal downtime for 100+ end users. 
Designed and built a C# Windows Forms application to ensure real-time access to critical system data during outages, enhancing operational continuity across the organization.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developing a mobile application in the music management industry.
Turning requirements and industry leading ideas into code.
Working in a remote, team format to troubleshoot and develop code to meet project deadlines.
positions.insights: Ruby on Rails, Git and +2 skills

educations.schoolName: Missouri University of Science and Technology
